description: What is Seedance 2 JP? Seedance 2 JP is a Japanese-friendly AI video generator designed for creators, marketers, and teams who want to turn text or images into short cinematic videos with less friction. You can use it to create text-to-video clips, animate still images into motion, and produce short AI videos for ads, social posts, concept drafts, and creative storytelling.
